description: Items shipped or staged whose license could not be established from shipped metadata. Listing an item here only lets generation proceed; it is not legal sign-off. Each item stays marked 'license unverified' in the notices until legal review replaces it with a verified license or removes the item.

entries.name: Denton typeface
entries.reason: Commercial typeface by Peregrin Studio imported from the design prototype (apps/app/src/prototype/asset-manifest.json). The font states 'All rights reserved' and names no license; an app/web embedding license must be confirmed or the face replaced before distribution.

entries.name: Piper LJSpeech medium voice model (int8)
entries.reason: The pinned voice model card lists the LJ Speech dataset as public domain and the piper-voices repository metadata declares MIT, but the card states no license for the trained voice itself; legal must confirm before the speech bundle ships.

entries.name: Sherpa-ONNX native build dependencies
entries.reason: Statically linked native dependencies are discovered during the reproducible speech build and their license files ship inside the hash-pinned model bundle; they are not enumerated in source, so their identifiers are not checked here.

entries.name: On-device elizaOS agent runtime payload
entries.reason: The staged runtime can ship in standard Android builds. Its Bun runtime and bundled agent dependency notices must be generated from the pinned upstream lockfile before any APK containing that runtime is distributed.

entries.name: pdf.js QuickJS sandbox
entries.reason: pdfjs-dist ships quickjs-eval.js/.wasm without a license file. The upstream sandbox build and QuickJS itself are believed to be permissively licensed, but no shipped license text establishes it.

entries.name: ONNX Runtime Web WebAssembly (statically linked components)
entries.reason: The onnxruntime-web WebAssembly binary used for in-browser speech statically links third-party libraries listed in ONNX Runtime's ThirdPartyNotices.txt (pinned at v1.30.0 and shipped verbatim here). Those notices span several licenses and are not enumerated per component, so their identifiers are not checked here; legal must review before the web build is distributed.
